svg.title: weightpatch scene: two directories converge into one sparse patch
svg.desc: Illustrative still: a base directory with 311 tensors and an edited copy with two changed tensors converge into a content-addressed .wpatch holding 2 changed and 309 unchanged tensors. The patch branches into apply and revert, which restores byte-identical weights, and into a GGUF screen that maps two tensors and reports 2 kept with 0 missing and 0 reshaped.
